description: The line plot illustrates the normalized average gate value across different models as a function of the number of experts, with the x-axis labeled "Experts" spanning values from 1 to 64 on a logarithmic scale. The y-axis, labeled "Normalized Average Gate Value," ranges from 0.00 to 0.20. Each line corresponds to a specific model or category, as indicated by the legend: Intent (orange), Summary (blue), Law (yellow), Translation (purple), Math (gray), Code (green), and Uniform (dashed black). The "Intent" model starts at a normalized average gate value of approximately 0.07 and decreases to around 0.01 at 64 experts. The "Summary" model begins at about 0.08 and declines to roughly 0.01. The "Law" model starts at approximately 0.06 and decreases to about 0.01. The "Translation" model starts at around 0.17 and decreases to about 0.01. The "Math" model begins at approximately 0.05 and decreases to about 0.01. The "Code" model starts at around 0.08 and decreases to about 0.01. The "Uniform" model remains constant at 0.01 across all expert counts. All models show a general downward trend in normalized average gate value as the number of experts increases.
